dessin: A role card: one portrait flat pale rectangle #FBFCF8 with a 2 px ink outline and sharp square corners. Across the top of the card, a header band about one quarter of the card height, separated from the body by one thin horizontal ink line; the header band is completely empty, plain pale color, nothing drawn in it. In the body below the line, exactly one adult person standing alone at the horizontal center, a full-body flat solid ink #23281F silhouette like the scale figure of an architect's elevation: short hair, trousers, arms along the body, facing the viewer, about half the card height tall, standing on one short thin horizontal ground line near the bottom of the card. Only one person. No tree, no building, no tool, no object, nothing else in the card.
